# PR4/5 - inspection-first durable wake observability

## Context capsule

This PR is item 4 of the rebuilt beta3 durable core stack. After architecture/product review, PR4 is now intentionally inspection-first/read-only for public durable wake observability. Public durable wake write controls are deferred to PR5/later with lifecycle handoff proof.

## Durable core stack overview

- PR1/5 - docs/RFC/boundary anchor.
- PR2/5 - runtime foundation/core plus terminal SQLite row immutability guard.
- PR3/5 - wake targets, durable producers, replay/resume semantics.
- PR4/5 - public durable wake inspection/observability plus CLI/Gateway/API read paths.
- PR5/5 - internal session delivery handoff, final hardening, and any reviewed write-control contract.

## What Problem This Solves

PR3 persists durable wake obligations and delivery attempts. Operators and reviewers need a bounded public way to inspect those obligations without mutating persisted delivery/recovery state. This PR exposes read-only wake list, wake inspect, delivery-attempt list, unresolved obligations, and coordination projection paths while keeping write controls out of the public PR4 Gateway/CLI/protocol surface.

## Scope

- Public Gateway/CLI/protocol inspection paths:
  - `durable.coordination.get`
  - `durable.obligations.list`
  - `durable.wake.list`
  - `durable.wake.inspect`
  - `durable.wake.deliveryAttempts.list`
- Public durable wake write controls removed/deferred:
  - `durable.wake.acknowledge`
  - `durable.wake.supersede`
  - `durable.wake.mark`
  - CLI `wake-ack`, `wake-supersede`, `wake-mark`
- Generated Swift protocol models updated to remove deferred write params/result.
- Shipped plugin SDK compatibility preserved for `NodeSession` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-runtime` with external packaged consumer proof.

## Non-scope

- No public durable wake mutation controls in PR4.
- No external transport delivery claim.
- No PR5 promotion.
- No cron changes.

## Architecture rationale

Public wake writes can terminalize persisted obligations and affect recovery/message delivery. PR4 keeps the public contract inspection-first so operators can diagnose durable state without creating compatibility expectations around write authorization, idempotency, terminal-state rejection, audit semantics, or lifecycle/session delivery handoff. Internal store write primitives remain available for PR5 integration but are not exposed as PR4 public API.

## Evidence

- Final head: `d7857aa47459c23e89fca642061b43010d5eeeb7`
- Head before implementation: `8856c95432bf3ab2b343a3896ee18362d25eaabf`
- Detailed proof artifact: `/Users/avo/aicos/runtime/openclaw-durable-pr-stack/pr4-inspection-first-implementation-proof-2026-07-13.md`
- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts src/commands/durable.test.ts test/release-check.test.ts` passed, 4 shards / 127 tests.
- Plugin SDK dts/export proof: `pnpm build:plugin-sdk:dts && node --import tsx scripts/write-plugin-sdk-entry-dts.ts && node scripts/check-plugin-sdk-exports.mjs` passed; declaration graph 4,389,302 bytes under 5,000,000 byte cap; `gateway-runtime.d.ts` includes `NodeSession`.
- Plugin SDK surface/API: `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` and `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check` passed.
- Protocol build: `pnpm --dir packages/gateway-protocol build` passed.
- External packaged consumer smoke: packed `openclaw-2026.7.1-beta.6.tgz`, typechecked `import type { NodeSession } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-runtime"`, loaded packaged `dist/plugin-sdk/gateway-runtime.js`, and called `errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, ...)`; passed.
- Lint/static fallback: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs <changed TS files>` passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Public-surface scan: only negative tests reference removed durable wake write names.

## Proof gaps / environment notes

- Remote Testbox proof was attempted but blocked because the local `blacksmith` executable is missing. AWS Crabbox warmup was also blocked by missing broker login. Focused local fallback proof was run and recorded.
- `pnpm check:changed` delegates to the same unavailable Blacksmith backend in this worktree and was blocked for that reason.
- Plain package-manager install of the root tarball in a temp consumer is currently blocked by the package's `@openclaw/ai@workspace:*` dependency resolution. The external consumer smoke therefore used the packed root artifact unpacked into external `node_modules/openclaw` plus installed declared runtime dependencies to prove the packaged subpath type/load behavior.

## ClawSweeper review focus

Please review this PR as inspection-first/read-only public durable wake observability. Public write controls are intentionally deferred; findings should treat public `acknowledge`, `supersede`, or `mark` exposure in PR4 as a regression, not a missing feature.


---

## PR4 silver recovery proof (2026-07-13)

Exact head: `a30e2b6ce4e5f1390599380aedc82078c98854f7`

ClawSweeper asks addressed:
- Restored `openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-runtime` to re-export canonical Gateway protocol `ErrorCodes` and `errorShape`; removed the hand-maintained duplicate runtime object.
- Exported protocol `ErrorCode` from the Gateway protocol barrel so `GatewayRuntimeErrorCode` also comes from the canonical protocol source.
- Verified shipped `openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-runtime` subpath with an extracted `openclaw-2026.7.1-beta.6.tgz` consumer importing/using `NodeSession`, `ErrorCodes`, and `errorShape`.
- Reconfirmed PR4 inspection-first surface: no public `durable.wake.acknowledge`, `durable.wake.supersede`, or `durable.wake.mark` Gateway/CLI/protocol API is present.

Redacted exact-head read RPC proof on `a30e2b6ce4e5f1390599380aedc82078c98854f7`:
- `durable.coordination.get` -> ok, returned coordination projection with `waitingReason: "child"` and redacted task/session refs.
- `durable.obligations.list` -> ok, returned unresolved uncertainty, pending wake, and open child obligations.
- `durable.wake.list` -> ok, returned pending redacted wake with one failed delivery attempt.
- `durable.wake.inspect` -> ok, returned wake, target resolution diagnostics, delivery attempts, unresolved uncertainty facts, and source refs.
- `durable.wake.deliveryAttempts.list` -> ok, returned the redacted failed delivery attempt.
- Fresh-enable proof created all 12 `durable_runtime_*` tables; disabled mode returned `INVALID_REQUEST` and created no SQLite file.

External packaged consumer proof:
```json
{
  "ErrorCodes": [
    "NOT_LINKED",
    "NOT_PAIRED",
    "AGENT_TIMEOUT",
    "INVALID_REQUEST",
    "APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND",
    "UNAVAILABLE"
  ],
  "errorShape": {
    "code": "UNAVAILABLE",
    "message": "consumer ok",
    "retryable": true
  }
}
```

Local gates passed:
- `pnpm lint --threads=8`
- `pnpm check:test-types`
- `pnpm check:docs`
- `pnpm protocol:check`
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:check-exports`
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check`
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check`
- `pnpm build:plugin-sdk:strict-smoke`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/release-check.test.ts` -> 1 shard, 56 tests
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/durable/wake-controls-inspection.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts src/commands/durable.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.test.ts src/durable/wake-delivery-replay.test.ts src/durable/wake-producers.test.ts src/durable/wake-target-resolver.test.ts test/scripts/durable-runtime-live-smoke.test.ts` -> 4 shards, 104 tests
- `git diff --check`

Full `pnpm release:check` reached the packed SDK smoke path, but the normal dependency-install consumer was blocked by local disk pressure (`ENOSPC`). After clearing generated temp/cache space, the extracted-package consumer above proved the shipped subpath without re-downloading the full dependency graph.

PR4 keeps the public contract inspection-first so operators can diagnose durable state without creating compatibility expectations around write authorization, idempotency, terminal-state rejection, audit semantics, or lifecycle/session delivery handoff. Internal store write primitives remain available for PR5 integration but are not exposed as PR4 public API.
